rules.statement: In an action rei vindicatio, the plaintiff must establish dominium to the land in dispute or risk having their claim fail.
rules.supporting_quote: 'To bring the action rei vindicatio plaintiff must have ownership actually vested in him-1 Nathan p. 362, s. 593 ' . . . . . . . ' This action arises from the right of dominium. By it we claim specific recovery of property belonging to us but possessed by someone else '- Pereira (1913 ed.) p. 300 quoting Voet 6.12.
